constraints.definition: CHECK ((((status = 'pending'::text) AND ("decidedBy" IS NULL) AND ("decidedAt" IS NULL) AND ("decisionCipher" IS NULL)) OR (status = 'superseded'::text) OR ((status = ANY (ARRAY['approved'::text, 'rejected'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'consumed'::text])) AND ("decidedBy" IS NOT NULL) AND ("decidedAt" IS NOT NULL) AND ("decisionCipher" IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.definition: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['pending'::text, 'approved'::text, 'rejected'::text, 'cancelled'::text, 'superseded'::text, 'consumed'::text])))

constraints.name: Form_designated_retention
constraints.definition: CHECK ((("designatedRetentionDays" IS NULL) OR (("designatedRetentionDays" >= 1) AND ("designatedRetentionDays" <= 36500))))

constraints.name: Form_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: Form_source_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((("sourceType" = ANY (ARRAY['form'::text, 'import'::text])) AND (("sourceType" <> 'import'::text) OR ((status = 'archived'::text) AND ("publishedVersionId" IS NULL)))))

constraints.name: Form_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['draft'::text, 'pendingApproval'::text, 'published'::text, 'paused'::text, 'archived'::text])))

constraints.name: Form_tenantId_serviceId_fkey

constraints.name: Publication_collection_window_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((("opensAt" IS NULL) OR ("expiresAt" IS NULL) OR ("opensAt" < "expiresAt")))

constraints.name: Publication_limits
constraints.definition: CHECK ((("responseCount" >= 0) AND ("responseCount" <= "maxResponses")))

constraints.name: Publication_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY (id)

constraints.name: Publication_status_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((status = ANY (ARRAY['active'::text, 'revoked'::text, 'expired'::text])))

constraints.name: Publication_tenantId_formId_fkey

constraints.name: Publication_tenantId_formId_formVersionId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId", "formId", "formVersionId") REFERENCES "FormVersion"("tenantId", "formId", id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: SecurityPolicy_activityReviewRetentionDays
constraints.definition: CHECK ((("activityReviewRetentionDays" IS NULL) OR (("activityReviewRetentionDays" >= 1) AND ("activityReviewRetentionDays" <= 36500))))

constraints.name: SecurityPolicy_approval_revision_check
constraints.definition: CHECK (("approvalRevision" > 0))

constraints.name: SecurityPolicy_approval_roles_check
constraints.definition: CHECK ((((cardinality("approvalRoles") >= 1) AND (cardinality("approvalRoles") <= 3)) AND ('owner'::"Role" = ANY ("approvalRoles")) AND ("approvalRoles" <@ ARRAY['owner'::"Role", 'admin'::"Role", 'security'::"Role"])))

constraints.name: SecurityPolicy_password_rules
constraints.definition: CHECK (((("minPassword" >= 12) AND ("minPassword" <= 128)) AND (("passwordMonths" >= 0) AND ("passwordMonths" <= 12)) AND ("passwordReuse" = ANY (ARRAY[0, 1, 10])) AND ("passwordDeferral" = ANY (ARRAY['never'::text, 'session'::text, 'period'::text])) AND ("passwordRevision" > 0)))

constraints.name: SecurityPolicy_pkey
constraints.definition: PRIMARY KEY ("tenantId")

constraints.name: SecurityPolicy_ranges
constraints.definition: CHECK (((("minPassword" >= 12) AND ("minPassword" <= 128)) AND (("sessionMinutes" >= 5) AND ("sessionMinutes" <= 10080)) AND (("retentionDays" >= 1) AND ("retentionDays" <= 36500))))

constraints.name: SecurityPolicy_tenantId_fkey
constraints.definition: FOREIGN KEY ("tenantId") REFERENCES "Company"(id) ON UPDATE CASCADE ON DELETE RESTRICT
